strings.A centimetre on screen is a number of pi: A centimetre on screen is a number of pixels, and that number depends on your display's pixel density (PPI). Two 1920×1080 monitors can be 22″ or 32″ — the same pixels, very different real sizes. That is why a ruler app must know your screen's true PPI, either from a device database or from a quick calibration.
